reviewedBy: Claude Opus 5.5 (Claude Code) + browse-tool, for Nino Chavez
method: Walked this branch's Cloudflare previews 8423f77e (8245514) and 3af153eb (d30f7b4), logged-out browser at 1280 and 390 px. /awards as a new visitor and as a past voter (submitted state in localStorage): closed intro ('Voting on the 2025 season awards is closed. These were the nominees.'), five categories, 19 read-only nominee cards, no buttons, no submit, no tallies, no announcement promise, no 2026 names, no horizontal overflow. Every results claim in the nominee list checked against the 2025 standings snapshot; two corrected (Maas, Maruyama). Unverifiable and left as voters saw them: the Messer / Mir / Adler roster (results list Kirschbaum / Messer / Mir), the Vandenberg brothers (in no 2025 results), and 'from 9th seed' (no Grass Launch seeding in Rally HQ). Share tags and the re-rendered Open Graph card read 'The 2025 season nominees. Voting is closed.' Server: POST /api/votes (awards:mvp) and /api/engagement (award_vote) both return 403 'Awards voting is closed'.
